A scroll sealed in a lead tube.

## The Text

Hear the words of the wanderer, who walked the shore road when the sea was young.

Seven stones stand where the land ends, and one of them is not a stone. Count them at low water and you will count eight.

Do not answer what calls your name from the eighth. It learned your name from the tide, and the tide forgets nothing.
